load_functions calls self.load without required stats argument. load_location empty-row fallback does same; these lazy paths are not independently qualified.

find_root selects largest cumulative row and also all parentless rows; threaded/recursive robustness is explicitly TODO. Combined totals can include overlapping cumulative subtrees and need provenance qualification.
PStatGroup.calculate_totals local_children branch sums children instead of local_children, omitting the named set. Group constructor discards supplied name by assigning empty string.

PStatRow maps raw call-count tuple into calls/recursive and per-call denominators; recursive versus total-call labels require comparison with exact pstats producer schema. No numerical timing validation executed.
Location construction copies mapping but reuses row objects and adds grouping parents, so function and location views share mutable relation state. Adapter tree filtering is part of interpretation.
